contract.name: scientist-mode-structure-smoke
contract.workload: 8 development and 8 disjoint structural scenarios; scoring relationships are predefined by the evaluator and do not estimate module utility
contract.resource_envelope: one serial Python process, deterministic simulator, 30 second timeout
contract.budget_and_stop_rule: two generations, three candidates each, six zero-cost generator calls

deterministic_plan.hypothesis: all five switches exercise every predefined structural stage
deterministic_plan.mechanism: enable all five optional interfaces in the smoke test

deterministic_plan.hypothesis: probe the predefined score when the ideation switch is disabled
deterministic_plan.mechanism: disable hypothesis generation while retaining downstream switches

deterministic_plan.hypothesis: probe the predefined score when the literature switch is disabled
deterministic_plan.mechanism: disable literature filtering and citation evidence

deterministic_plan.hypothesis: probe the predefined score when the tree-manager switch is disabled
deterministic_plan.mechanism: disable branch expansion and experiment management

deterministic_plan.hypothesis: probe the predefined score when the analysis switch is disabled
deterministic_plan.mechanism: disable robust aggregation and evidence interpretation

deterministic_plan.hypothesis: probe the predefined score when the paper-review switch is disabled
deterministic_plan.mechanism: disable structured research packaging and claim review

budget.wall_time_scope: generation, development evaluation, freeze, and holdout after baseline initialization
